dub-links 2.0.1

- Adds comprehensive support for managing Dub short links, lead and sale conversion tracking, and real-time analytics via the superagnt unified API.
- Features include full link CRUD (create, read, update, delete), bulk operations, tags, folders, customers, and custom domains.
- Integrates the complete conversion tracking pipeline with endpoints for analytics, events, partners, bounties, commissions, and payouts.
- Requires only a SUPERAGNT_API_KEY and a connected Dub account; clear prerequisites and error messages help with configuration.
- Enhanced documentation for both MCP-connected and API key/curl-only workflows.
